content.text: {"sections":[{"section":"summary","body":"For the period ended September 30, 2026, Pellham Grain & Milling Co. is in breach of its Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio covenant, with a calculated ratio of {{fact:5b61399a-8531-42bb-a229-39ef26af3fee}} against a required minimum of {{fact:77721a76-1ddd-4eb0-9539-9ed32d14186a}}. The borrower's certificate reports the same figure and does not claim compliance. Revenue grew, but EBITDA, margin and net income all declined from a year earlier. The breach has been escalated to committee, where a decision on the bank's response rests."},{"section":"performance","body":"Trailing twelve-month revenue rose to {{fact:feec2f6c-6bf2-49fc-8f0d-79ddfd8d8fee}} from {{fact:37bccb70-7d43-45a2-a70f-8f67e835c7da}}, growth of {{fact:0e6386c1-1cec-4cfa-a583-550f24a47103}}. EBITDA fell to {{fact:376b13d2-5c18-4801-b3c3-6ab92f677c0a}} from {{fact:39b5f109-e6e2-4790-a144-b8cf8d5b446e}}, and margin narrowed to {{fact:6d071d8a-543f-47e0-b247-e9a3a6c1e013}} from {{fact:6a53e63b-9dc8-43a3-837a-cc4948521671}}. Net income declined to {{fact:0df2f74a-b434-4457-9add-ea93f6a1ada7}} from {{fact:392aada4-769b-48d6-a169-068a8453c66b}}. Total debt decreased to {{fact:3fd90036-87a1-411a-acb1-813671cf799d}} from {{fact:b75476be-45f5-4968-8bc0-64619b5e61bd}}, and cash rose to {{fact:ccc82cd2-44fc-4301-9425-11adfb25410c}} from {{fact:8f348b20-18b0-4fad-a35d-3baa0366c977}}. The current ratio eased to {{fact:89d345b2-4482-4c13-8842-2317d543e682}} from {{fact:7a3fdac4-5cc9-496b-b1e0-5a7ead9d6e3f}}. Days sales outstanding moved to {{fact:b9d05fc2-a62d-4777-ba3e-ae603201ce6f}} from {{fact:4bef6a5a-52a4-44ca-8014-dc6da089b306}}, and days payables lengthened to {{fact:c5ee79c2-f9ed-4be1-9204-c65fbc24bfa5}} from {{fact:a0ad66e2-ee5c-42c2-be02-53932f328ca9}}."},{"section":"covenants","body":"The Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio is in breach: the bank calculates {{fact:5b61399a-8531-42bb-a229-39ef26af3fee}} against a minimum of {{fact:77721a76-1ddd-4eb0-9539-9ed32d14186a}}, a cushion of {{fact:b37d8dd6-944b-4c18-b234-30e87bc1ee47}}. The certificate reports {{fact:3a9a3c97-f1e6-4f16-acce-83e6cc7bcddb}} and does not claim compliance. Minimum Tangible Net Worth is compliant at {{fact:f4199c79-1df2-4a71-a6a0-58f6b56a79ee}} against {{fact:89307b87-bb76-40df-8240-b5fd7d78bc6d}}, a cushion of {{fact:f60b904c-7b80-47cc-a7c4-7d89b68c87df}}. Total Leverage is compliant at {{fact:526bfd83-5e8b-44a7-af47-d35d3b8f08f5}} against a maximum of {{fact:7d274137-6f7a-4fc3-aed7-c1d0d2219f39}}, a cushion of {{fact:f62c9987-19f3-4020-af97-8790628cdb57}}. Certificate figures agree with the bank's calculations for all three covenants."},{"section":"collateral","body":"The borrowing base supporting the Revolving Line of Credit, as of September 30, 2026, agrees with the bank's records, with no mismatched lines. Availability stands at {{fact:61dc1f3e-3a41-4d1b-9cba-bee8971179af}}."},{"section":"risks","body":"The most significant item is the Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio breach, recorded as a high-severity work item and decided as an escalation to committee. A medium-severity low-headroom signal fired on the same covenant, reflecting negative cushion of {{fact:b37d8dd6-944b-4c18-b234-30e87bc1ee47}}; no other signal fired. Interest coverage improved to {{fact:e3461dc7-8ac2-4ea9-80b0-8f063f505c45}} from {{fact:fddaca9e-a593-4b03-b109-e26fd5533a24}} while fixed charge coverage fell short, so a reviewer may want to examine which fixed charge components drove the shortfall; those components are not among the facts held."}]}
